system.description:
Energies are yours to command and flow, sometimes through your own body.

Assign one of the dice you rolled at the end of the power source step to an Elemental/Energy power. If you already have an Elemental/Energy power, you can skip it, add a different Elemental/Energy power, or swap the die with one of your new dice.

Assign one of the remaining dice to one of these powers:

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.RECkAlMY7v9N4KNI]{Absorption}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.5GDEdsr0jrDmWApP]{Flight}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.fBd3ZqSIUowckCHO]{Leaping}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.I7Gr7LIRFGAzC1NE]{Swimming}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.hQIArnjTuOBxYoPT]{Signature Vehicle}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.fubw8CJu2mXFZJUD]{Signature Weaponry}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.MCfvbWF3GUPDWbLz]{Transmutation}

• Select from Elemental/Energy powers category

Assign any remaining dice to any of these qualities:

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.qualities.Item.brt7V1SXffIWpPTl]{Magical Lore}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.qualities.Item.yfrz6TSCgB2EzH4E]{Science}

• Select from Mental qualities category

• Select from Physical qualities category
